A gold ring's melt value is what the metal alone is worth — $4,377 gold puts 14K at $82 a gram. Purity sets the price: 24K is priced as pure gold, 18K at three quarters, 14K at 58.3%, 10K at 41.7%. Melt value is a floor, not what a piece sells for retail.
